integrity_notes: An exhaustive combinatorial discrete-Morse proof and a dependency-free verifier are included. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specific twelve-vertex Frucht graph and its ordinary matching complex are classified.
No general classification of Halin or planar matching complexes is implied.
The public literature comparison cannot exclude every unindexed equivalent result.
title: A perfect Morse model for the Frucht-graph matching complex
